Goal of script: Create a phyloseq object from decontamination output files, and look at output in microviz.

Loading phyloseq tutorial here: https://vaulot.github.io/tutorials/Phyloseq_tutorial.html

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Change path below to where you have your "OME_analysis_utilities.R" saved
path_to_utilites <- "/Users/setta/Documents/OME_R_scripts"

# Source utlities files for all ome functions.
source(paste0(path_to_utilites,"/OME_analysis_utilities.R"))

# Install and load libraries for neccessary packages with ome utility fxn:
pkg_check() 
# can add additional packages by changing to: pkg_check(c("package","package))

# region of interest:
region <- "MiFish"
```

## Load data files:

```{r load-seq-data}
# otu table
otu_table <- read_asv_table(here("MiFish_final_asv_table.csv"))
# taxa table
tax_table <- read_tax_table(here("MiFish_final_taxonomy_table.csv"))
# metadata file
meta <- read_metadata(here("MiFish_final_metadata.csv"))
# fasta file
fasta_df <- read_fasta(here("MiFish_final_seqs.fasta"))

```

## Create phyloseq object:

```{r make-phyloseq-obj}
phyloseq_object <- create_phyloseq_object(
                       asv_path = here("MiFish_final_asv_table.csv"), 
                       tax_path = here("MiFish_final_taxonomy_table.csv"),
                       meta_path = here("MiFish_final_metadata.csv"),
                       fasta_path = here("MiFish_final_seqs.fasta"),
                       # if you want to choose particular columns for metadata 
                       # replace null with list of column id's e.g. c("samp_name", "station")
                       col_select = c("samp_name","station_id",
                                      "samp_collect_device",
                                      "expedition_id",
                                      "salinity","temp","diss_oxygen"), 
                       output_dir = "",
                       filename = "MiFish_phyloseq_obj")

```

Filter phyloseq object by metadata:

```{r filter-phyloseq-meta}
# make sure microViz is installed:
microviz_check()
# other packages recommended by microviz
pkg_check(c("ggtext", "ggraph", "DT", "corncob"))
# add sample names to column for rep id:
sample_data(phyloseq_object)$sample_name <- sample_names(phyloseq_object)

# filter and add pcr_rep column:
phyloseq_object_filt <- phyloseq_object %>%
  # can filter out particular expedition id's (cruises) by uncommenting the next line
  # microViz::ps_filter(expedition_id!="OC0919") %>% 
  microViz::ps_mutate(pcr_rep = str_extract("samp_name", "PCR\\d+$")) %>%
  subset_taxa(!is.na(Domain) & Domain != "Unknown")
```


## MicroViz data exploration

When running this code, a browser tab will open, and allow you to explore data.
To continue on with R code, stop the code in the console and continue to the next R code chunk

```{r microViz-bargraph}
# run microviz to explore data
# example data from corncob package
ps_obj_cleaned <- phyloseq_object_filt %>%
  tax_fix() %>% # not required but helps with visualization
  # tax_agg(rank = "Class") %>%
  phyloseq_validate() # %>% ord_explore()
# create bargraph
bargraph <- ps_obj_cleaned %>%
  comp_barplot(tax_level = "Genus", n_taxa = 8, label = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(vars(samp_collect_device), scales = "free") +
  coord_flip()
# view
bargraph

# create figure folder:
create_dir()
# save figure (change width and height as needed)
ggsave(
  filename = here::here("figures",paste0(region,"_genus_barplot.png")), 
  width = 10, 
  height = 8, 
  dpi = 300
)

```

Ordination plot

```{r ordination}
# run ordination with microViz
ps_nmds <- ps_obj_cleaned %>%
  dist_calc(dist = "bray") %>%
  ord_calc(method = "NMDS")

# Generate the ordination plot
ordination <- ord_plot(ps_nmds, color = "samp_collect_device", label = NULL)
ordination

# create figure folder:
create_dir()
# save figure (change width and height as needed)
ggsave(ordination,
  filename = here::here("figures",paste0(region,"_ordination.png")), 
  width = 8, 
  height = 8, 
  dpi = 300
)

```
